desc: Read N, intervals, Q, queries; build difference array `diff` of size MAX+3 (MAX = 500000).
Compute prefix sum `c[i]` for i=1..MAX+1 (c[i] = number of intervals covering i).
Compute `final[i]` for i=MAX+1 down to 1: if c[i]==0 then final[i]=i else final[i]=final[i+c[i]] (with final[MAX+2] defined as MAX+2).
Read Q queries and for each X output final[X].
Use fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read) and print each answer on its own line.
